jobs.description:
The Opportunity
We strive to be world leaders in electric power by helping countries to have greener, stronger and cleaner electricity. By bringing sustainable energy to more and more people, we can reduce our impact on the planet. When you work with us, you will be part of a higher purpose where each department contributes. Together we can encourage the next innovation - to make life better for everyone.
The Global SCM organization delivers value and service to HVDC’s large infrastructure projects around the world. If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing large SCM projects close to the end customer by applying to the following role! 
In the role as Tender SCM you work individually and will be responsible for SCM scope in the Tender Core Team, with a key role interacting with HVDC stakeholders in tender execution. You will be based in Ludvika where the rest of the team in Sweden is located.
How you’ll make an impact
You will be on the driving seat for any needs or issues related to supply chain, engaging other departments (engineering, documentation, finance, etc.) for your input.
Perform cost calculation on the material, resources, and other costs related to SCM scope.
Provide feedback to tender team related to time schedule, terms & conditions, payment milestones, customer requirements.
Perform risk assessment from SCM perspective.
Connect with SCM Category Managers and the suppliers, for at least but not limited to, request for Quotation (RFQ), negotiation, discussing special customer requirements.
Be the SCM representative in the tender core team.
Contribute to strategic work, lessons learned, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to tender meetings as well as in review meetings.
In collaboration with Category Management, keep updated on market developments in pricing and deliveries.

Your background 
Preferably you have some years of relevant working experience, so you feel comfortable in taking decisions, questioning and take full responsibility for outcome of the work in your project by the SCM organization.
You are a team player with strong communicative and collaborative skills, and you are comfortable with thinking outside of the box.
We think that you are an energetic, endurant, responsible, and independent person with great structure skills. You are curious and open to changes, value integrity, get things done in a timely manner, and always drive for efficiency.
You should be comfortable in expressing yourself, written and spoken, in English and preferable in Swedish.
You should have a continuous improvement mindset and comfortable in handling Cost calculations.

More about us
Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today!

Your goal is to foster strong, long-term relationships and drive customer retention and growth.
Responsibilities

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, building trusted advisor relationships.

Conduct regular check-ins and Business Reviews to ensure customers are satisfied and achieving their goals.

Lead the onboarding process for new enterprise customers, ensuring a smooth transition and successful implementation of our products/services.

Gather feedback through surveys and product usage data, identifying trends to share with internal teams.

Represent customers’ needs and success stories to drive customer-centric improvements across the company.

Anticipate customer needs by analyzing usage patterns, engagement metrics, and feedback.

Manage and update customer information in the CRM system, ensuring data accuracy and tracking all customer interactions. Use the CRM to monitor customer health, manage tasks, and maintain a clear view of the customer lifecycle.

Qualifications 

5+ years of experience working B2B as an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Key Account Manager or Senior Customer Success Manager.

Experience with support tools and platforms like HubSpot.

Excellent presentation and organizational skills.

An innovative self leader that is service minded.

Proficiency in languages like German, and Dutch is a plus.

Experience in the field of SaaS is a requirement.

Fluency in both written and spoken English and Swedish.

What you get

A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".

If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.

Other location-specific benefits.

Our values at Xensam
Rebellious We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
Humane We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
Harmony We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher, aquatic microbial ecology & environmental genomics
jobs.description:
Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment
We are looking to recruit a creative and motivated postdoctoral researcher to study microbial diversity and biogeochemical/metabolic function by analysing larger metagenomic and metatranscriptomid datasets from field expeditions and laboratory experiments.
About the position
As a postdoktor, you are expected to;
Organize and analyse large microbial, metagenomic and metatrancriptomic datasets.
Take a leading role in collaborative research focused on microbial ecology and metabolic function with focus on the Central Arctic Ocean.
Interpret and report own research and findings in scientific publications and presentations.
Support and collaborate with colleagues and students in bioinformatic analyses.
Apply for funding to develop the research area further.

Your profile
We are looking for a candidate with a PhD in microbiology, ecology, bioinformatics or related disciplines. Strong skills in bioinformatics and in-depth analyses of microbial genomic data is a requirement for the position. Research experience in aquatic microbial ecology is a merit. Experience in biostatistics, bioinformatic tool development and database handling is a merit. Proficiency in scientific writing demonstrated by first authored publications in international scientific journals is a merit. Mentoring and training of students is a merit. Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement.
As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most. If there are special circumstances, such a degree may have been awarded earlier. Special circumstances include leave due to illness, parental leave, positions of trust within trade union organizations, service within the total defence system, or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or other employment/assignments relevant to the subject area.    
About us
The Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment is working with applied environmental science, with a national responsibility for assessing the condition of Swedish surface waters with respect to water chemistry, pollution and aquatic biota. The research focuses on geochemical and hydrological processes, aquatic ecology and biodiversity, microbial ecology as well as on environmental chemistry and aquatic ecotoxicology. The department has about 150 employees, of which approximately half are researchers/doctoral students and the other half are technical and administrative staff.
For more information about the department visit: http://www.slu.se/aquatic-sciences
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.occupation: Material Planner at a Global Life Science Company!
jobs.description:
Join a leading global player in the healthcare sector as a Material Planner. In this role, your expertise directly ensures the smooth production of life-saving medical products within a structured, collaborative, and fast-paced team environment.
About the role
As a Material Planner, you will serve as the vital link between customer demand, material supply, and internal production. Working closely with a dedicated team of buyers and planners, your primary focus will be driving daily operational flows to prevent material bottlenecks and secure on-time deliveries. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position where your proactive coordination makes a tangible impact on global healthcare supply chains.
You are offered
A long-term consultant assignment up to one year at an industry-leading company.
Structured onboarding with dedicated mentors to ensure you feel confident in your role from day one.
Hybrid flexibility – once you are fully onboarded, you will have the option to work remotely one day per week.

Work tasks
In this role, you will manage operational material planning for the main production line, ensuring high material availability and accurate system data. Your daily tasks include:
Manage operational material planning for the main production line to ensure optimal material availability.  
Coordinate with internal functions such as purchasing, warehouse, and production to resolve material shortages.  
Execute and maintain work orders and customer orders within the ERP system (Oracle).  
Prioritize customer orders and actively monitor potential material bottleneck lists.  
Investigate inventory discrepancies, identify root causes, and perform necessary stock adjustments.  
Update and communicate production priority lists to keep all operational teams aligned.  
Participate in daily management meetings to report on material status and escalate risks when necessary.

We are looking for
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
At least 2 years of experience in in operational planning flows - such as production planning, material control, or order management, within manufacturing, laboratory operations, or similar environments.
Hands-on experience working with ERP systems (specifically managing production orders, sales orders, and inventory transactions) as well as MRP/production planning tools.
Understanding of material planning, lead times, production capacity, inventory accuracy, and backorder management.
Ability to manage shifting priorities, coordinate work across different functions, and drive issues through to resolution.
Fluency in English (written and spoken).

It is meritorious if you have
Basic knowledge of Swedish.
Experience from manufacturing processes within the Life Science, MedTech, or Healthcare sectors.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Intellectually curious: You are a fast learner who understands digital workflows and how different processes interconnect within an ERP environment.
Strong at prioritizing: You are able to balance customer commitments, material constraints, and production capacity.
Social: You build strong cross-functional relationships and communicate priorities clearly.
Orderly: You ensure reliable planning data, accurate transactions, and up-to-date follow-up lists.
Responsible: You take ownership of tasks and drive issues through to resolution.
Stable: You maintain focus and act flexibly when material shortages, demand, or priorities shift.

 
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Company Description
foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description
Aim:
The Area Manager is responsible for managing and developing logistics operations in their region, ensuring that the courier fleet, E-vehicle fleet, rider hub, and office staff have the resources and support needed to deliver high-quality results. The role drives local execution of central strategy, oversees rider training, recruitment, and performance management, while ensuring workplace responsibility for thousands of riders and office employees. Additionally, the role is accountable for quality frameworks, follow-ups, training, and implementation of new procedures, as well as fostering a strong and engaged courier community.
In short: To lead and optimize local logistics operations in your respective areas by empowering the courier fleet and team leaders, driving strategic initiatives, ensuring E-vehicle fleet excellence, and building a strong courier community.
Job Description
• Taking full responsibility for our logistics operations in their geographical allotted areas, including the rider hub and E-vehicle fleet.
• Acting as workplace representative for thousands of employed riders and office staff.
• Ensuring that delivery couriers and team leaders have all the tools, training, and resources necessary to deliver excellent results.
• Driving strategic initiatives based on central strategy and managing the local team to reach set goals quickly.
• Leading performance management of our courier and E-vehicle fleet in the region.
• Ultimately responsible for the execution of the quality framework, including follow-ups, training, and procedure changes, ensuring consistent implementation across teams.
• Building and continuously strengthening the courier community through engagement, support, and communication.
• Reporting closely to the Logistics Quality Manager but also our Head of fleet and while collaborating across functions to ensure alignment with national and central priorities.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Logistics

5-6 years of Last mile logistics experience with at least 2–3 years of solid managerial experience successfully leading and managing a large team.

Proven professional experience is needed while getting it from the last mile logistics industry is a plus.

Bilingual or full professional proficiency in both Swedish and English (strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages).

Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment

Leadership Principles:
At foodora, we expect every employee to act in alignment with our leadership principles; Own it, Dive Deep, Deliver Value Fast, Raise The Bar, Bring Good Vibes and Stay Humble. Meaning: Own your work, understand it deeply, move fast on what matters, lift and raise the bar for yourself and others, spread positivity, and stay curious and humble every step of the way.
Additional Information
What’s in it for you
Wellness allowance topped with the opportunity to participate in many work/life balance initiatives at foodora such as wellness hour & reduced price on massage.

Employee discount at foodora (woho!)

Occupational pension, incl. premium exemption insurance, accident insurance and life insurance.

foodora Learning - Monthly learning sessions about different topics, such as the q-commerce industry, negotiation techniques and project management combined with a structured onboarding and inspiring courses within our learning tool Sana

Great deals at Benifix (for e.g. gym membership, e-bikes hotels, audiobooks, streaming services, clothes, kitchen supplies… and so much more!

Awesome AW’s and (pink) parties!

jobs.occupation: Contract Operation Manager- YouTube content to leading search engine compan
jobs.description:

This is a consultancy assignment starting as soon as possible, for up to 6 months with the possibility of extension.
Responsibilities include:
Work with stakeholders to help them understand policies and processes and assist other stakeholders on escalations/exceptions, with some guidance.
Ideate and scale solutions that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and/or success metrics (e.g., cost savings, capacity planning, time savings) at a pod, market, regional, or global level, with some guidance.

Contribute to execution of projects to generate impact and solve scaled operations problems.

Process design and improvement
Industry knowledge
Operational SLA knowledge
Project management
Data analysis & synthesis
Client/partner management
Identifying automation opportunities
Team Management
Stakeholder relationship management
Domain specific knowledge
Business operations knowledge
Queue and ticket management
Customer support
Negotiation
Business acumen

Basic Requirements:
Strong general business practice understanding, contract handling, and financial data processing.
Proven stakeholder management experience in high-pressure commercial environments.
Fluency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred Qualifications:
Understanding of talent, media, and creative agency contracting (e.g., standard SLAs between creative production agencies and YouTube creators).

We are looking for a Product Manager for Service Contracts for a company in Gothenburg. Start is December 7th, 1 year limited contract to begin with. This role is full-time and 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Our client’s Service Contracts team is a global center of excellence for Service Contracts, responsible for developing, managing, and commercializing service contract solutions that maximize customer uptime and support profitable growth.
Working closely with sales regions, markets, and cross-functional teams around the world, the team continuously evolves its offerings to meet changing customer needs and industry trends. As electrification, connectivity, and data-driven services reshape the transport industry, Service Contracts play an increasingly important role in delivering customer value throughout the vehicle lifecycle.

As part of the client’s team, you will have the opportunity to influence the future of the service business, collaborate with colleagues across the globe, and contribute to innovative solutions that support sustainable transport.

This role includes occasional international travel and offers extensive exposure to global stakeholders and business initiatives.

As Product Manager for Service Contracts, you will be responsible for developing and strengthening our client’s global service contract offering. You will work closely with colleagues across markets, functions, and regions to ensure our products create value for customers while supporting long-term business ambitions.

You will:

Drive the development and commercialization of Service Contract products globally.

Lead commercial strategies, product positioning, and business optimization.

Identify market opportunities and customer needs through data, insights, and close market collaboration.

Develop and execute the long-term Service Contract strategy together with the client's headquarters, internal teams, and local market organizations.

Collaborate across functions including Sales, Aftermarket, Business Development, Systems Solutions, Digital Services, Marketing, Legal, and Engineering.

Play a key role in driving service contract business growth and securing long-term customer success.

This position offers a unique opportunity to influence future service solutions and help shape the business models that will support the next generation of transport.

As Product Manager, you will provide global commercial support to markets within the Service Contracts area. We believe you have:

5+ years of experience in Product Management, Project Management, Business Development, Marketing, Aftermarket Services, or a similar role.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at different levels.

A proactive mindset, curiosity, and the ability to take initiative and drive activities through to completion.

A customer-centric approach and a passion for delivering business value.

Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.

Experience within the automotive, transportation, mobility, or service-related industries is considered an advantage.

This role requires fluency in English.
 This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is December 7th, 1 year limited contract to begin with. This role is full-time and 100% onsite in Gothenburg.
 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

Are you an Electronics Engineer with a passion for product development?
We are now looking for an experienced Electronics Engineer to join us! Our hardware team within R&D is responsible for developing hardware and architecture designs for our instruments, and for maintaining them through the product care process.
As an Electronics Engineer, you will enhance our hardware offering by applying your expertise in product development and in the design of both digital and analog electronics, further strengthening our successful development department. Electronics engineering is crucial to taking new products from concept to production readiness, and to improving existing products.
Biotage offers a creative, global work environment with stakeholders in regional marketing, international R&D, supply chain, the global service team and customer support. As an Electronics Engineer, you will be part of Biotage R&D and report to the Hardware & Architecture Manager, based at our headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden.
Key tasks and responsibilities:
Develop electronics solutions for new and existing Biotage products

Prepare manufacturing documentation for printed circuit boards and cabling

Plan and perform technical investigations and tests for new projects, and resolve technical problems in existing products

Transform technical requirements into electronics for instrument control

Ensure that instruments meet regulatory requirements, including performing EMC tests

Replace discontinued electronic components in existing products

Document and manage changes in our product life-cycle management system

Education and Experience:
A bachelor’s degree or higher in electronics engineering or a similar field

At least five years of working experience as an electronics engineer

Proficiency in design using Altium; Eagle is a merit

Expertise in:

Analog and digital electronics (schematics and layout)

EMC (planning and testing)

Sensors

Motor drivers

Power electronics

Hands-on experience with soldering and measuring instruments; knowledge of the production standards IPC-600, FSD 5115 and ESD is a merit

Experience with IEC/EN 61010, LVD, EMC and other electronics standards

Desired skills and qualities:
To excel in this role, you should have strong problem-solving skills and enjoy collaborating with others to achieve high-quality results

You are driven, independent, curious and proactive

You have a quality focus and understand the importance of product life-cycle management

Personal drive and commitment are highly valued

You have a structured way of working

You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

You have advanced Swedish skills

What we offer:
Biotage offers an innovative, collaborative and productive work environment where you work and learn with stakeholders in regional marketing, R&D, supply chain, the global service team and customer support, to deliver the very best products and processes. As a valued Electronics Engineer, you will be an essential part of Biotage R&D, liaising with and reporting to the Senior Hardware & Articheture Manager, based at Biotage Headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden.
About Biotage:
Biotage is a global supplier and solutions partner to a wide range of customers within drug discovery and development and analytical testing. With strong expertise in separation and purification technologies, and a focus on leveraging intelligent workflow solutions, we aim to efficiently support the advancement and protection of human health. Learn more at biotage.com
Application:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to Biotage’s continued growth journey? We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as selection may take place on an ongoing basis.

Join us in building Stockholm’s new metro and play a key role in one of Sweden’s largest infrastructure projects.
Are you an experienced mechanic who enjoys hands-on work, troubleshooting technical equipment, and working in a dynamic site environment? We are looking for a skilled and motivated Mechanic to join our team and help ensure the reliability and performance of our equipment and machinery.
Main Responsibilities as a Mechanic
As a Mechanic, you will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing a wide range of equipment used in tunneling and construction operations. The role combines mechanical maintenance with welding and steel fabrication work to support daily operations and minimize downtime.
Key Responsibilities
Service, maintenance, and repair of tunnel machines and associated equipment.
Preventive and corrective maintenance of site vehicles, site cars, pumps, generators, and other machinery.
Troubleshooting and fault-finding on mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
Welding, steel fabrication, and repair work as required.
Inspection of equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation.
Replacement of worn or damaged components.
Documentation of maintenance activities and repair records.
Support operational teams with technical expertise and rapid response to breakdowns.
Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety procedures and company standards.

Qualifications and Experience
We are looking for candidates who have:
Relevant mechanical or technical education, or equivalent work experience.
Experience in maintenance and repair of heavy equipment, construction machinery, industrial equipment, or vehicles.
Good knowledge of mechanical systems, hydraulics, and pneumatics.
Practical experience in welding and steelwork.
Ability to read and understand technical drawings and manuals
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
A valid driver's license (Category B)

The following are considered an advantage:
Experience working in tunneling, mining, construction, or infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of diesel engines and hydraulic systems.
Welding certifications.
Experience with heavy construction equipment and pumps.

Personal Qualities
You are a reliable and safety-conscious team player who takes pride in delivering high-quality work. You work independently when required, have a proactive attitude, and thrive in a fast-paced operational environment.
What We Offer
As an international company, we offer a truly global environment, reflected in both our offices and projects. You will have many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from different parts of the world, supporting both your personal and professional growth. We are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and offer a wellness allowance.
Information and Application
Please submit your CV and cover letter in English. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Itinera’s HR department at Hrsweden@itineraspa.se.
If Itinera and the Mechanic position sound like the right opportunity for you, we encourage you to apply today. The application deadline is 19 December 2026, but please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the closing date.
About Itinera S.p.A.
We are an international construction company with roots in Italy, specializing in large-scale infrastructure and civil engineering projects for more than 80 years. Established in 1938, the company is part of the ASTM Group, operating in over 15 countries with 14,000 employees.
In Stockholm, we are currently working on the extension of the metro lines at Hammarby Kanal station, Södra Hagalund, and Arenastaden. We have also constructed the new Skurubron in Nacka.
Our Swedish headquarters are in Solna, and we currently employ more than 300 people.
We have chosen to handle this recruitment internally; advertising salespersons or external recruiters are kindly declined.

jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Orthopaedic Career in Coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Dignus Medical collaborates with several established healthcare providers across Sweden. We are currently receiving ongoing requests from hospitals in central Sweden seeking specialist physicians in orthopaedics. These opportunities arise regularly as healthcare providers expand their orthopaedic services and strengthen their specialist teams.
We are continuously interested in connecting with Orthopaedic Surgeons who are open to exploring professional opportunities in Sweden.
The Role
As a specialist in orthopaedics, you will work in a modern hospital environment alongside multidisciplinary teams focused on high-quality patient care. The clinical work typically includes both elective orthopaedic surgery and acute trauma care, depending on the structure of the department.
Common responsibilities include:
Assessment and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and injuries
Elective orthopaedic procedures depending on experience and subspecialty
Participation in trauma and emergency orthopaedic care
Outpatient consultations and follow-up care
Collaboration with physiotherapists, radiologists, and other medical specialists
Participation in clinical development and quality improvement work

Hospitals in this region often manage a broad orthopaedic case mix, offering opportunities to work with both common orthopaedic conditions and more complex cases.
Location and Lifestyle
The opportunities are located in a region of central Sweden known for its coastal landscapes, forests, rivers, and open countryside. The area offers excellent access to nature and outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, fishing, skiing, and boating.
Daily life is practical and well-organized. Cities in this region offer short commuting distances, accessible housing, and well-developed public services. Schools, childcare, and healthcare services are easily available, making the region suitable both for individuals relocating alone and for physicians moving with their families.
The lifestyle combines a calm environment with reliable infrastructure and convenient travel connections to larger Swedish cities.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in Orthopaedics
Solid clinical experience in orthopaedic practice
Experience in trauma care and elective orthopaedic procedures is beneficial
Ability to work independently while collaborating in multidisciplinary teams
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary
Access to a free language course with a private tutor

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in learning more?
Contact us to learn more about current and upcoming opportunities for orthopaedic specialists in Sweden, or submit your application today. Dignus Medical looks forward to helping you explore the next step in your career.
We look forward to receiving your application!

The Supply chain and Procurement Manager supports the entire lifecycle of our enzyme-based solutions—from procuring raw materials and components to delivering the final product to the customer. This expanded role consolidates the entire end-to-end supply chain, giving you single-point accountability for spend management, inventory health, distribution efficiency, and daily business operations.
The role
We are seeking an agile and strategic Supply chain and Procurement Manager to lead our supply chain from start to finish, from the suppliers we buy from, through our contract manufacturers, to the customers who receive our products. In this multifaceted role, supporting our product line director and the overall company activity, you will be responsible for procuring highly specific materials related to enzymes and biomanufacturing, managing day-to-day activities with existing raw material suppliers and production facility, supporting cost-saving procurement strategies, and optimizing logistics networks. You will also oversee daily warehouse, fulfilment, international shipping and business workflows to maximise productivity and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a master of cross-functional execution who balances hands-on operational ownership and a higher-level picture of supply chain and process efficiency oversight.
You will choose and negotiate with suppliers, plan materials for each CMO campaign, keep inventory accurate across our sites and arrange shipments that arrive on time and comply with regulations. When costs rise, stock runs low or a delivery slips, you will spot it early, bring the right people together and drive it to a solution. This is a hands-on role with plenty of room to build the function your way as we grow.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the purchasing of raw materials, from request to delivery.
Identify and qualify new suppliers and CMOs in collaboration with the Product Line Director 
Develop and maintain the supply base, focusing on quality, delivery and cost efficiency.
Establish and update agreements with key suppliers and CMOs, including pricing and purchase terms.
Plan and coordinate material supply for production campaigns at our CMOs, and follow up on timelines.
Monitor inventory levels to secure material availability while avoiding excess stock.
Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and ensure compliance with import/export regulations.
Follow up on spend against budget and drive cost-saving initiatives as needed.
Streamline daily operations and improve processes for ordering, receiving and shipping. 

Who you are
Required
A university degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering or similar.
At least 5 years of experience in production planning, supply chain or procurement within the manufacturing industry, specialty chemicals, cosmetics, food or a similar industry.
Experience from driving cross-functional collaboration, improvement work and process development.
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written

Nice to have
Experience navigating global trade tariffs, customs clearance protocols, and international sourcing networks.
Proven ability to operate as subject matter expert in a company building its operations function.
Experience in a scale-up moving from R&D to pilot or commercial production, including technology transfer to CMOs.

 
What we offer
A people-driven, forward-looking company of 30+ people from more than 15 nationalities;
A fast-moving, collaborative and multidisciplinary team shaping the future of industrial biotech;
A start-up environment with minimal red tape, real responsibility and ownership, and room to learn and grow;
A competitive salary and wellness grant;
25 days of paid annual leave plus bridge days, occupational health and injury insurance, and an occupational pension plan mirroring ITP-1.
